title: STEPS: Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.10194v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a model as its own teacher under privileged context, providing token-level supervision on the model's own reasoning trajectories. However, persistent all-token guidance can degrade training in our math RL setting. Such guidance may unnecessarily constrain non-critical tokens and reinforce biases induced by privileged information unavailable at inference. Motivated by these risks, we propose STEPS, a selective OPSD framework that controls the location, direction, and duration of distillation. STEPS identifies critical spans in student rollouts, applies forward KL to key spans or reverse KL to error spans, and gradually transitions to pure GRPO after a short distillation phase. Across four models from three families, STEPS improves mean accuracy over GRPO. translated_title: STEPS：面向推理的选择性同策略自蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）让模型在特权上下文下充当自己的教师，为模型自身的推理轨迹提供token级别的监督。然而，在我们的数学强化学习场景中，持续的全token指导可能会损害训练效果——这种指导可能不必要地约束非关键token，并强化由推理时不可获得的特权信息所引入的偏差。基于这些风险，我们提出了STEPS，一个选择性的OPSD框架，用于控制蒸馏的位置、方向和持续时间。STEPS识别学生模型生成轨迹中的关键片段，对关键片段应用前向KL散度、对错误片段应用反向KL散度，并在短暂的蒸馏阶段后逐渐过渡到纯GRPO训练。在来自三个模型家族的四个模型上，STEPS的平均准确率均优于GRPO。在Qwen3-8B上，使用强标注器时，STEPS在四个数学基准和GPQA-Diamond上的平均准确率实现了2.76%的绝对提升。
tldr: STEPS通过选择性地控制自蒸馏的位置、方向与持续时间——对关键片段施加前向KL、对错误片段施加反向KL，并在短暂蒸馏后过渡到纯GRPO——在多个模型的数学推理强化学习训练中显著超越GRPO。
en_tdlr: STEPS is a selective on-policy self-distillation framework that controls the location, direction, and duration of distillation—applying forward KL to critical spans and reverse KL to error spans before transitioning to pure GRPO—thereby improving math reasoning accuracy over GRPO across multiple models.
